EXP-04.evidence: Only feedback reason tags such as unjustified_refusal or not_matched and free text (packages/data-provider/src/feedback.ts); no failed-intent or unsupported-request logs.

EXP-05.evidence: No opportunity or proposal objects (searched packages/api/src, packages/data-schemas/src/models).

EXP-06.evidence: A new agent, skill or feature can be enabled for selected groups or roles via ACL sharing and principal config overrides (api/server/routes/accessPermissions.js; app/service.ts:396-518); no success metric or recorded keep-or-kill.

AIR-03.evidence: File search over uploaded files via RAG API with citations, web search, memory and MCP tools (config.ts:830-847; packages/api/src/files, web, memory). Indexing is per upload, not a governed context layer over product data.

AIR-04.evidence: Retrieval and tools mostly run as the requesting user: file ACL (packages/data-schemas/src/methods/file.acl.spec.ts), memory authorization (packages/api/src/memory/authorization.ts + spec), skill permission checks, per-user MCP OAuth and OBO. Admin-configured MCP servers and actions with static credentials run with the operator's credentials for every user.
AIR-04.alt_note: Most sources are permission-scoped with tests.

AIR-05.evidence: No evaluation datasets or harness in the repository (searched e2e, packages/api/src, workflows); Langfuse integration is opt-in tracing (packages/api/src/langfuse).

AIR-06.evidence: Prompt and model changes ship through code review and ordinary CI only; no evaluation gate (searched .github/workflows).

AIR-07.evidence: Messages persist tool calls, arguments, outputs, model and user per conversation; audit categories agent_run and tool_call exist but have no actions (types/admin.ts:50-73). With Langfuse configured, per-run traces with model, inputs and tool calls are viewable by operators and in an in-product trace viewer (packages/api/src/langfuse/trace.ts, packages/api/src/traces).

AIR-01.evidence: Provider abstraction across many endpoints and custom endpoints configured in librechat.yaml and admin config overrides; per-feature models for titles, summarization and memory (config.ts:2845-2858); fallbacks for summarization (run.ts:1512-1552). No declared, tested resilience strategy for chat.

AIR-02.evidence: Transactions record tokens and cost per request and user, enabled by default (transactions schema config.ts:2832; packages/data-schemas/src/methods/spendTokens.ts, transaction.ts); balances enforced per user only when balance.enabled (default false, config.ts:2816-2817; middleware/checkBalance.ts); admin views via scripts (config/list-balances.js, user-stats.js).

AIR-08.evidence: Feedback is collected per message with model (message.ts:103-120) but not analysed in product by default; Langfuse feedback export opt-in (langfuse/feedback.ts). No drift alerts.
